analysis_contract.joint_failure: P(M=0 | A=1,O=1), operational, not a causal mechanism
analysis_contract.compatibility: One explicit comparison group in one run lock; identical system, revision, settings, repeats and kind.
analysis_contract.primary_weighting: Equal dependence-group means; J uses only groups with A=O=1 eligibility.
analysis_contract.secondary_weighting: Micro: all planned task slots; conditional J pools eligible task slots.
analysis_contract.failures: Missing planned attempts, invalid outputs, refusals and adapter errors are false; never drop failed slots.
analysis_contract.zero_eligible: Null J for zero-eligible groups; omit them from macro J, retain them in shared resampling and report counts.

analysis_contract.qualification: Full and qualified sets, construction-wide and identical across conditions; pending is not rejected.
